{{Youmay|the sport|[[anti-grav ball]], a piece of sporting equipment}}
'''Anti-gravball''' was a sport. Alongside [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxing]], [[Cracian thumper]] racing, and [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]], anti-gravball was regularly staged at the [[Tapani Arts and Sports Complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vycinyth]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
